quotations.old_english: Ðone greádan his árfæstnesse and his frófre hé gebrǽt
Hé bæd ðone ælmihtigan for his árfæstnysse þ-bar; hé þám preóste gemiltsode
Ongeán þǽre árfæstnysse hé sylð árleásnysse, þæt hé ne árige his underþeóddum ne his gelícum

source_text: árfæstnes. Add: I. piety:--Pietas árfæstnys, Angl. xi. 107, 8. Æ-acute;rfastness, Wülck. Gl. 251, 18. II. mercy, clemency, kindness:--Ðurh ðá mildheortnesse his árfæsðnesse per pietatis viscera, Past. 99, 1. Ðone greádan his árfæstnesse and his frófre hé gebrǽt sinum pietatis expandit, 407, 11: Gr. D. 146, 28. Hé bæd ðone ælmihtigan for his árfæstnysse þ-bar; hé þám preóste gemiltsode, Hml. S. 6, 167: 30, 350. Ongeán þǽre árfæstnysse hé sylð árleásnysse, þæt hé ne árige his underþeóddum ne his gelícum, Wlfst. 59, 16.
